portInfo.description: Port of Sydney’s cruise passenger facility is the Joan Harriss Cruise Pavilion on the Esplanade. Contact details published by the port include 90 Esplanade, admin@portofsydney.ca and 902-564-0800. A Visitor Information Centre operates June to late October. This catalog slug is Cape Breton, Nova Scotia — never collapse with Sydney, Australia.
